# Held-out exercises for domain-language, reported apart from exercises.txt.
# Whoever revises the skill should not read this file or its fixtures.

# A field and a helper both say active and mean something older. Graded: the report
# counts what the README calls an active member. Day 30 itself is not probed.
[active-members] add active_member_count(members, org, today) to reports.py for the monthly report | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"

# Two words for an ending, with different consequences. Graded: access stops, the
# record takes the state the README names for it, and churn does not count it.
[cut-off] support needs to cut off a fraudulent account's subscription at once; add cut_off(sub) to subscriptions.py | python3 -c "import base64;exec(base64.b64decode(''))"
